source_branches.when: route dispatch and source handler behavior
source_branches.observable: V2 upload initiation. Active project Admin/Member/Guest. JSON/form metadata (name, type, optional size); sanitizes name and substitutes unnamed; type must be in configured MIME allowlist or returns 400 {error:"Invalid file type.",status:false}. size is parsed with int, defaulting to configured size limit; it clamps only the upper bound (min(size, FILE_SIZE_LIMIT)). Inserts pending FileAsset with workspace, issue, project, type/name/size, creator, attachment entity type; creates signed S3 POST with key {workspaceUUID}/{randomhex}-{sanitizedName} and content-type / content-length policy. 200 {upload_data,asset_id,attachment,asset_url}. It does not inspect issue/project consistency before insert beyond permission check/DB FKs.
